tldr: Sell exclusively on the Shopify Theme Store — no other marketplaces.
Your theme must look, feel, and function completely differently from all existing themes.
High-quality visuals, clean layout, consistent design, frictionless customer shopping experience.
Support 21+ required features: subscriptions, gift cards, faceted search, and more.
All 16 required page templates must be present and functional.
Lighthouse Performance ≥ 60 and Accessibility ≥ 90 on mobile + desktop.
Every page type (product, cart, blog, collection list, 404, etc.) has specific rules.
No fake urgency, no app-dependent features, no unlicensed assets.
Chrome/Firefox: latest 3 releases; Safari/Edge: latest 2; Samsung Internet supported.
Plain CSS only — no SCSS. No pre-minified files (except ES6 & 3rd-party libs).
SEO meta tags, rich snippets, and no robots.txt.liquid file.
Full keyboard navigation, color contrast, alt text, and valid HTML.
Open Graph + Twitter Card tags; leave social fields empty by default.
Use Shopify's font_picker, color settings, and official terminology throughout.
Responsive images with lazy loading on all screen sizes.
1–2 word theme name, unique, no Shopify brand names or industry labels.
Every release must include a version number and release notes.
One fully realistic demo store per preset, matched to its industry + catalog size.
Public documentation and a contact form linked from your Theme Store listing.
Respond to merchant support within 2 business days; fix critical bugs immediately.

items.label: Shopify Theme Store only
items.detail: your theme must be sold exclusively here. No ThemeForest, Creative Market, or any other marketplace.

items.label: No designer credits or affiliate links
items.detail: remove all links to your own website, social profiles, or affiliate programs from the theme files.

items.label: No external marketing material
items.detail: the theme files must not contain any promotional content for your brand or other services.

items.label: Completely different overall experience
items.detail: not just one page, but the entire journey across core templates and elements must feel original. You may reuse libraries but how you assemble them must be substantially different.

items.label: Can't be reproduced by tweaking settings
items.detail: reproducing your overall experience should require substantial structural changes, not just adjusting settings or superficial styling.

items.label: Original art direction
items.detail: create an inventive, distinct system for headers, navigation, product cards, media treatments, and page structure.

items.label: Cosmetic tweaks don't qualify
items.detail: spacing changes, color/typography swaps, gradients, shape dividers, background effects, animations, or adding a few sections or settings to an existing codebase is not enough.

items.label: Uniqueness at the architectural level
items.detail: embed uniqueness into the theme's code structure so it remains unmistakably its own as new features are added.

items.label: Skeleton Theme only
items.detail: Dawn and Horizon are no longer accepted as base codebases for new submissions. Only Shopify's Skeleton Theme is approved.

items.label: Stand out visually
items.detail: clearly target a specific merchant type or industry with a thoughtful, deliberate visual style. Must not closely resemble existing themes.

items.label: High-quality visuals only
items.detail: sharp, properly sized images and icons. No blurry, stretched, pixelated, or clip-art-level imagery anywhere.

items.label: Harmonious color palette
items.detail: cohesive colors throughout that work together without clashing or reducing readability.

items.label: Clear grid structure
items.detail: consistent, deliberate spacing and alignment between sections and blocks throughout all pages.

items.label: Strong content hierarchy
items.detail: guide attention using size, color, contrast, and position. Key content first, secondary content visibly subordinate.

items.label: Flexible layouts
items.detail: must look visually appealing and balanced even when content length, image count, or text quantity changes. No awkward gaps or broken layouts.

items.label: Limited, consistent fonts
items.detail: avoid overusing fonts; choose complementary pairs used consistently throughout.

items.label: Uniform interactive elements
items.detail: buttons, links, and forms must use consistent styles, sizes, colors, and behaviors everywhere.

items.label: Merchant-first theme editor
items.detail: settings must use simple, merchant-friendly language, be grouped logically, and balance flexibility with opinionated defaults.

items.label: Clear, effortless navigation
items.detail: customers can easily navigate from homepage to product discovery, product pages, cart, and checkout without confusion or friction.

items.label: Thoughtful product discovery
items.detail: the design guides customers toward relevant products or collections through intuitive menus, featured collections, or clearly presented recommendations.

items.label: Frictionless shopping interactions
items.detail: all key customer actions — choosing options, adding to cart, editing cart items, and moving to checkout — must be clear, intuitive, and immediately responsive.

items.label: Fully realistic demo
items.detail: real product photos, professionally written original text. Absolutely no Lorem Ipsum or placeholder content.

items.label: Relevant sections only
items.detail: only include sections and interactions that logically support the type of business and products in the demo.

items.label: Inspiring to merchants
items.detail: the demo inspires merchants with engaging content, attractive layouts, and intentional product displays.

items.label: Sections Everywhere (OS 2.0)
items.detail: merchants can add, remove, and rearrange sections on any page.

items.label: Discounts
items.detail: show discount amounts on cart, checkout, and order pages for items and full orders. Must be supported on the cart page.

items.label: Accelerated checkout buttons
items.detail: include Shop Pay, PayPal, Google Pay on product pages and cart pages. Buttons must be enabled by default. Do not modify the branded button colors.

items.label: Faceted search filters
items.detail: filter by price, availability, type, vendor, and variant options on collection and search pages.

items.label: Gift cards
items.detail: include a proper gift card template that renders the gift card issued to a customer upon purchase.

items.label: Image focal points
items.detail: respect the focal point setting merchants assign to images via the image_picker setting or the Files page.

items.label: Social sharing images
items.detail: add a page_image object so merchants can display a thumbnail when sharing store links on social platforms.

items.label: Country & currency selector
items.detail: let customers select their currency and country/region when merchants sell internationally. Must follow Shopify's UX guidelines.

items.label: Language selector
items.detail: let customers switch languages when the merchant sells in multiple languages. Must follow Shopify's UX guidelines.

items.label: Multi-level dropdown menus
items.detail: support nested navigation menus (menus inside menus).

items.label: Newsletter signup form
items.detail: a form for visitors to subscribe to email marketing.

items.label: Pickup availability
items.detail: show local pickup availability on product pages without needing to add to cart. Must be supported on the product page.

items.label: Related product recommendations
items.detail: auto-generated related products section on product pages.

items.label: Complementary product recommendations
items.detail: merchants can show "pairs well with" products on product pages.

items.label: Rich product media
items.detail: support 3D models, embedded videos, YouTube and Vimeo on product pages, featured product sections, and quick view features.

items.label: Search box or link to search
items.detail: must include a search template and predictive search functionality.

items.label: Selling plans / subscriptions
items.detail: show selected subscription plans in cart and on customer order pages. Must be supported on both the cart page and customer page.

items.label: Shop Pay Installments banner
items.detail: show a "pay in installments" message on product pages. Must be supported on the product page.

items.label: Unit pricing
items.detail: display price per unit on collection, product, cart, and customer pages.

items.label: Variant images
items.detail: show the correct image when a customer selects a specific product variant.

items.label: Follow on Shop button
items.detail: include the Shop app follow button using the login_button Liquid filter. Do not modify its official colors.

items.label: 16 required files
items.detail: Must include all of the following:theme.liquid404.jsonarticle.jsonblog.jsoncart.jsoncollection.jsonindex.jsonlist-collections.jsonpage.jsonpage.contact.jsonpassword.jsonproduct.jsonsearch.jsongift_card.liquidsettings_data.jsonsettings_schema.json

items.label: Do NOT include
items.detail: Remove config/markets.json before uploading — it is not allowed in your submission.

items.label: Sections on every template
items.detail: except Customer Account, Gift Card, and Checkout pages.

items.label: Custom Liquid section
items.detail: must include a setting of type liquid and be available on all section-supporting templates.

items.label: Header and footer use Section Groups
items.detail: allows merchants to dynamically add, remove, and reorder sections in the header and footer without touching code.

items.label: Product page uses individual blocks
items.detail: price, vendor, description, and other elements must each be separate, reorderable blocks in the main product section.

items.label: App blocks supported
items.detail: main product section and featured product section must accept @app blocks.

items.label: Custom Liquid blocks
items.detail: add these wherever app blocks are allowed. Must include a setting of type liquid.

items.label: Tested across 3 pages
items.detail: scores are averaged across homepage, collection page, and product page, for both desktop and mobile.

items.label: Pages must have real content
items.detail: sections cannot be empty during testing. Fill everything with actual images and text.

items.label: Test before submitting
items.detail: use Shopify's benchmark dataset and Lighthouse CI tool to pre-check scores and avoid rejection.

items.label: Payment logos
items.detail: use enabled_payment_types and payment_type_svg_tag filter. Icons must be in full color.

items.label: Language attribute
items.detail: the <html> element must specify a lang attribute populated with request.locale.iso_code.

items.label: Use routes object
items.detail: use Shopify's routes object for all dynamic URLs. Never hard-code paths.

items.label: Don't touch content_for_header
items.detail: never modify or parse content_for_header — Shopify manages this internally.

items.label: Full product info
items.detail: show product.title (not truncated), variant.price, variant.unit_price, compare-at price, product.description, and all option names and values.

items.label: Media & variants
items.detail: all images must be displayed and viewable. Variant images must update when the associated variant is selected. Different image ratios must not break the layout.

items.label: Tax messaging
items.detail: use cart.taxes_included to show a "taxes included" message when applicable.

items.label: Required buying functions
items.detail: variant selectors split into separate options, quantity selector, Add to Cart button, price/compare-at/sold-out callback, and first available variant pre-selected.

items.label: Color swatches
items.detail: must be supported using swatch.image and swatch.color.

items.label: Gift card recipient form
items.detail: gift card products must include a send-to-recipient form using form.email, form.name, form.message, and gift_card.send_on.

items.label: Required feature support
items.detail: product recommendations, rich product media, accelerated checkout buttons (enabled by default), pickup availability, and Shop Pay Installments must all work on the product page.

items.label: Collection header
items.detail: output collection.title (not truncated), collection.description, and collection.image.

items.label: Product grid
items.detail: list products with product.title, product.price, product.images, variant.unit_price, and at least one piece of media per product.

items.label: Badges & price ranges
items.detail: show Sale badge or product.compare_at_price_max. Use product.price_varies to show min–max price range.

items.label: Filtering, sorting & pagination
items.detail: include product sorting, an empty collection message, and pagination or lazy loading. Grid must not break due to varying image aspect ratios.

items.label: Collection title required
items.detail: output collection.title (not truncated) for each collection.

items.label: Use featured image
items.detail: use collection.featured_image, which falls back to the first product image if no collection image is set.

items.label: Pagination or lazy loading
items.detail: must paginate or lazy load collections.

items.label: Per-item details
items.detail: show title, unit_price, image, final_price, quantity, and options_with_values for each line item.

items.label: Cart summary
items.detail: display cart.total_price, a checkout button, quantity editing per item, an empty cart message, and tax-inclusive indicator.

items.label: Advanced cart features
items.detail: support cart notes, selling plans, automatic discount codes, and accelerated checkout buttons (enabled by default).

items.label: Refresh on quantity update
items.detail: all line items must refresh when quantity changes so the cart total updates correctly.

items.label: Required content
items.detail: must output page.title and page.content.

items.label: Contact page template
items.detail: must include an alternate page.contact.json template for a contact form.

items.label: Blog
items.detail: output blog.title. Each article must show article.title, article.image, and article.excerpt_or_content (not article.content). Paginate.

items.label: Article
items.detail: show article.title, article.comments, and article.published_at (not article.created_at). Comments must be paginated and submission workflow must work without moderation.

items.label: Search
items.detail: return products, blog posts, and pages using object_type. Show a "no results" message. Paginate.
clear "page not found" message and helpful next steps (search bar or homepage link).

items.label: Gift Card
items.detail: Apple Wallet support, gift card code, QR code (min 120×120px), and store logo or shop.name.

items.label: Password
items.detail: store logo or shop.name, shop.password_message, and a storefront password entry field.

items.label: Customer
items.detail: display line_item.unit_price in order history. Must support selling plans and unit pricing.

items.label: Consistent RTE content styling
items.detail: H1–H6, blockquotes, lists must look identical across all templates.

items.label: Scripts hosted on Shopify
items.detail: all JavaScript must be served through Shopify's CDN. Only approved 3rd-party libraries are exempt.

items.label: Don't interfere with Shopify admin
items.detail: no code that interferes with, or augments, any native Shopify feature in the theme editor or Shopify admin.

items.label: Add rel="nofollow"
items.detail: any link pointing to a Shopify domain must include the rel="nofollow" attribute.

items.label: Protocol-relative URLs
items.detail: never hard-code http:// or https:// in asset paths.

items.label: Licensed assets only
items.detail: all third-party plugins, fonts, and images must have the appropriate licenses.

items.label: No app-dependent features
items.detail: all theme features must work without requiring a separate Shopify app to be installed.

items.label: No half-built app features
items.detail: wishlists, appointment scheduling, cart-level discount codes, Instagram feeds, and similar app-like functionalities are not allowed even in partial form.

items.label: No fake urgency
items.detail: no fictitious countdown timers, fake stock levels, or made-up visitor/activity counts.

items.label: Safari (Mac)
items.detail: Must work on Latest 2 releases.

items.label: Chrome (Mac & PC)
items.detail: Must work on Latest 3 releases.

items.label: Firefox (Mac & PC)
items.detail: Must work on Latest 3 releases.

items.label: Edge (PC)
items.detail: Must work on Latest 2 releases.

items.label: Mobile Safari (iOS)
items.detail: Must work on Latest 2 releases.

items.label: Chrome Mobile (Android & iOS)
items.detail: Must work on Latest 3 releases.

items.label: Samsung Internet (Android)
items.detail: Must work on Latest 2 releases.

items.label: Instagram in-app browser
items.detail: Must work on Latest release (iOS + Android).

items.label: Facebook in-app browser
items.detail: Must work on Latest release (iOS + Android).

items.label: Pinterest in-app browser
items.detail: Must work on Latest release (iOS + Android).

items.label: No SCSS or Sass files
items.detail: .scss and .scss.liquid files are not allowed. Compile to plain .css or .css.liquid before submitting.

items.label: No pre-minified CSS or JS
items.detail: Shopify auto-minifies these. The only exceptions are ES6 JavaScript files and pre-minified third-party libraries.

items.label: SEO meta tags on every page
items.detail: include the theme SEO metadata snippet with title tag, meta description, and canonical URL on all pages.

items.label: Google rich product snippets
items.detail: add structured data markup on product pages. Validate using Google's Structured Data Testing Tool.

items.label: Do not include robots.txt.liquid
items.detail: Shopify manages this file automatically. Including your own version will interfere with search engine crawling.

items.label: Full keyboard navigation
items.detail: every element, including dropdown navigation, must work with keyboard only.

items.label: Visible focus states
items.detail: every focusable element must show a clear visual highlight when focused via keyboard.

items.label: Alt text on all images
items.detail: use image.alt or image_tag: alt: for product images. Decorative images must use alt="".

items.label: Connected form labels
items.detail: every form input must have a unique ID and a label linked via the for attribute.

items.label: Valid HTML
items.detail: themes must be built with valid HTML throughout.

items.label: Color contrast ratios
items.detail: body text: minimum 4.5:1. Large text (18pt+) and non-text elements: minimum 3:1.

items.label: Logical focus order
items.detail: keyboard tab order must match DOM order: top-to-bottom, left-to-right.

items.label: Touch targets ≥ 24×24px
items.detail: all tappable elements must be at least 24×24 CSS pixels. Exception: inline body text links.

items.label: Distinct heading styles
items.detail: H1 through H6 must each look visually different from one another.

items.label: Social media icons
items.detail: include a set of social media icons merchants can link to their profiles.

items.label: Open Graph and Twitter Card tags
items.detail: shared links must display a proper title, description, and thumbnail image on all social platforms.

items.label: Empty defaults
items.detail: all social media URL fields in theme settings must be left empty by default. Never pre-fill with dummy links.

items.label: Clear, logical settings
items.detail: settings must use simple, merchant-friendly language and be grouped logically. Avoid unnecessarily deep nesting.

items.label: Correct grammar and spelling
items.detail: all setting labels and informational text must be grammatically correct and free of spelling errors.

items.label: Helpful default text
items.detail: default values should indicate how to use the setting. No Lorem Ipsum or demo store content as placeholders.

items.label: Favicon setting required
items.detail: must include an uploadable favicon setting.

items.label: Logo handles any aspect ratio
items.detail: landscape, portrait, or square logos must all work without breaking the layout.

items.label: Every setting must have a label
items.detail: no unlabeled settings anywhere in the theme.

items.label: Menu defaults
items.detail: header link list settings default to main-menu; footer link list settings default to footer.

items.label: Referenced resources must exist
items.detail: any default value pointing to a product or collection must exist in all stores.

items.label: Standard metaobject definitions only
items.detail: custom or app-owned metaobject definitions cannot be used as metaobject_type.

items.label: Include a theme_info section
items.detail: required in the settings_schema.json.

items.label: Editor changes reflect instantly
items.detail: any change in the theme editor must appear immediately in the preview panel.

items.label: Sentence case
items.detail: capitalize only the first word and proper nouns. "Image gallery" not "Image Gallery."

items.label: Descriptive names, not numbers
items.detail: use "Top left, Top center" not "Position 1, Position 2." Avoid subject repetition in section headings.

items.label: American English
items.detail: "color" not "colour," "center" not "centre," "canceled" not "cancelled," "catalog" not "catalogue."

items.label: No ampersands
items.detail: always write "and" in full. Never use &.

items.label: Statements not questions
items.detail: "Use a custom logo" not "Use a custom logo?"

items.label: Active voice, verb-first buttons
items.detail: "Upload image," "Add section," "Choose font."

items.label: Technical spec formats
items.detail: image sizes as 64 x 64px required or 3:2 aspect ratio recommended; word counts as 32 words max.

items.label: Name relates to function
items.detail: use names like "Header," "Product list," "Slideshow," or "Image gallery."

items.label: Suggested names
items.detail: Header, Featured products, Featured collections, Slideshow, Image gallery, Logo list, Newsletter, Map, Blog posts, Testimonials, Footer.

items.label: Preset names relate to content type
items.detail: use names like "Image and text," "Map," "Columns," or "Blog articles."

items.label: Use content placeholders
items.detail: if a preset features images, videos, or icons, display placeholder content so merchants can see how it looks before adding their own media.

items.label: Use font_picker setting type
items.detail: all font selections must use the font_picker setting type.

items.label: Always set a default font
items.detail: every font picker must have a default value (e.g., default: work_sans_n6).

items.label: Only use available library fonts
items.detail: defaults and preset fonts must exist in Shopify's currently available fonts list.

items.label: Load all font variants
items.detail: use the font_modify filter in CSS to load bold, italic, and bold-italic variants for every font used.

items.label: Custom fonts are not allowed
items.detail: all fonts must come from Shopify's library.

items.label: Minimum 4 colors required
items.detail: you must define at least 4 colors in your color system.

items.label: Every background needs a matching foreground
items.detail: each background color setting must have a corresponding foreground (text/icon) color setting.

items.label: Use proper color type
items.detail: all color settings must use type: color in the settings schema.

items.label: Good contrast pairing
items.detail: foreground and background combinations must have sufficient contrast for readability.

items.label: Responsive image strategy
items.detail: all images must adapt and look correct across phones, tablets, and desktops. Small icons are exempt.

items.label: Lazy loading required
items.detail: images must load only as they're needed, minimizing the number of images loaded initially per page.

items.label: No Shopify brand names
items.detail: avoid names the same as or similar to Shopify products, events, or branded content (e.g., "Polaris," "Unite," "Shopify").

items.label: No company or partner names
items.detail: your Partner account name is already shown automatically on the listing page.

items.label: No platform or SEO terms
items.detail: avoid generic words like "Performance," "Mobile," or "Sales."

items.label: No industry or category names
items.detail: don't name your theme after a niche like "Fashion," "Electronics," or "Jewelry."

items.label: 1–2 words, under 30 characters
items.detail: short, memorable, easy to spell and pronounce. Avoid trendy or unusual spellings.

items.label: Unique name required
items.detail: the name must not already exist in the Shopify Theme Store or on other platforms.

items.label: One preset shares the theme name
items.detail: at least one preset must take the name of the parent theme exactly.

items.label: Multiple presets need a /listings folder
items.detail: each preset goes in its own subfolder inside /listings in your theme ZIP.

items.label: Single preset — no /listings folder needed
items.detail: you can skip the /listings folder entirely if you only have one preset.

items.label: Each preset must match its demo on install
items.detail: colors, typography, and layout must match the demo store when the merchant installs the preset.

items.label: Demo images won't transfer
items.detail: plan for this; images don't carry over on install.

items.label: Version number required on every submission
items.detail: every upload — first submission or update — must include a version number.

items.label: Release notes required
items.detail: clearly highlight the main features and changes in each version so merchants know what they're getting.

items.label: Helps merchants stay informed
items.detail: version numbers let merchants know which version they're on and whether newer updates are available.

items.label: One demo store per preset
items.detail: every theme preset must have at least one demo store. Create it as a Client Transfer Store from your Shopify Partner Dashboard.

items.label: Match the preset's industry and catalog size
items.detail: the demo must fit the tags assigned to the preset. Each preset's install state must also match the demo's expectations.

items.label: Use Bogus Gateway or test mode
items.detail: all demo stores must have the Bogus Gateway or Shopify Payments test mode enabled, with all other checkout options disabled.

items.label: Real, original text content
items.detail: no Lorem Ipsum, no onboarding text, no profanities anywhere.

items.label: Don't change "Powered by Shopify"
items.detail: the powered_by_link link cannot be altered and must contain only powered_by_link.

items.label: No affiliate links
items.detail: not allowed anywhere in the demo store.

items.label: Add rel="nofollow" to Shopify links
items.detail: any link in the code pointing to a Shopify domain must include the rel="nofollow" attribute.

items.label: Only show built-in theme features
items.detail: no text embedded in images (unless physical products, infographics, or badges), no animated GIFs mimicking theme functionality, and no apps (except free review and translation apps).

items.label: Have rights to all assets
items.detail: obtain appropriate rights for all images, brand names, and content per the Shopify Partner Agreement. Use Shopify Burst for royalty-free images.

items.label: Both are mandatory
items.detail: you must have theme documentation and a public support contact form ready before your theme launches.

items.label: Link both from your Theme Store listing
items.detail: merchants must be able to find them directly from your theme page.

items.label: Correct grammar and spelling
items.detail: all documentation must be well-written and error-free.

items.label: Match your theme settings language
items.detail: terminology in docs must be consistent with labels used in the theme editor.

items.label: Keep it updated
items.detail: update documentation when Shopify changes something or when you release a new theme version.

items.label: Include an FAQ section
items.detail: answer common merchant questions proactively.

items.label: Warn merchants before editing code
items.detail: remind them to duplicate the theme first and suggest hiring a Shopify Partner for customizations.

items.label: Required fields
items.detail: Name, Email Address, Store URL, Description of Problem (text area), File Upload (for screenshots), and Auto-Responder confirmation.

items.label: Optional but useful
items.detail: Theme Name (if you have multiple themes) and Subject (should auto-fill the email subject line).

items.label: Keep it simple
items.detail: no unnecessary fields like budget, phone number, or project type.

items.label: Mobile-friendly
items.detail: if using a popup/modal form, it must work well on mobile and be directly linkable from the Theme Store.

items.label: Merchants reach you through your contact form
items.detail: link it from both the Shopify Theme Store listing and your theme documentation.

items.label: Reply within 2 business days
items.detail: all support requests must be acknowledged and responded to within two business days.

items.label: Fix technical issues promptly
items.detail: broken layouts, dead links, and logical errors must be fixed in a timely manner.

items.label: Fix critical bugs immediately
items.detail: serious bugs affecting the shopping experience must be fixed right away, or your theme risks temporary removal from the store.

items.label: Extra services are optional and separate
items.detail: customizations and app integrations can be offered as paid add-ons but cannot be included in the theme price.

items.label: Supporting merchants is a full-time commitment
items.detail: all current Theme Partners have dedicated support teams. Shopify merchants generate thousands of support tickets per month. New partners typically underestimate the time required.
